songLine: Staff only. The Gatekeeper, on strike: nobody gets in, not even the good stuff; too tired to argue.
The Gatekeeper, overcompensating: I protect you till you can't breathe; seven locks, zero air.
reason: Parentheses unspeakable; article added so the two Gatekeeper cards sound like a matched pair.

songLine: The reviews are in. Inner Critic with the megaphone: you failed, and I'm loud about it; a goblin with fresh batteries.
reason: Parenthetical prop turned into a spoken phrase.

cardName: Future Self: The One Who Left
songLine: Fortune booth. Future Self, the one who left: I took the other road; postcards from the timeline next door.
reason: A colon inside the name would collide with the 'Name: claim' colon; comma instead.

cardName: Future Self: The One Who Stayed
songLine: Future Self, the one who stayed: I stayed and stayed; same room, same chair, older.
Wait… What? / That's the card. Meaning collapses suddenly; a neon duck walked through the plot.
reason: wr2 blind review: the name stands alone on its own line, and 'That's the card.' tells the listener it was a title, not a reaction. The song line is two lines: 'Wait… What?' / this line.

songLine: Cosmic PowerPoint, broken: I have the answer to everything, roughly; slide one, everything. Slide two, error.
The Exit Sign that moves: leaving's easy, follow me; this way out. No, this way. No, this way.
reason: Parentheses unspeakable; article added for flow.

songLine: Therapist and Client: chaos welcome, structure holds; two chairs, I hold the frame, you keep the answers.
Seven-Day Witness: give me one boring week; Monday, same. Tuesday, same. Thursday, oh.
reason: Numeral spelled out so Suno does not read 'seven dash'.

songLine: The Back Cover Manifesto: stay symbolic, stay theatrical, just stay; paws up, curtain.
reason: Slash unspeakable. Lore 'Stay symbolic stay theatrical' gets commas plus the wr2 tag 'just stay' (blind-review suggestion for a stronger second-to-last line).
